claim.claim-text: 1. A method for obtaining system information, applied to a terminal side, configured to be applied in a scenario where a cell transmits a plurality of synchronization signals and has a plurality of pieces of system information and comprising:
2. The method according to claim 1, wherein obtaining the correspondence between the feature information and the transmitting position of the system information comprises:

directly obtaining a locally pre-stored correspondence between the feature information and the transmitting position of the system information; or obtaining a correspondence between the feature information and the transmitting position of the system information based on the node information.

3. The method according to claim 1, wherein obtaining the transmitting position of the system information corresponding to the node information based on the feature information and the correspondence further comprises: obtaining a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on the feature information and the correspondence.
4. The method according to claim 3, wherein obtaining the frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on the feature information and the correspondence comprises:

determining a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a frequency of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determining a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determining a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a scrambling code sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determining a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a frequency domain position of the synchronization signal and the correspondence; and obtaining the frequency domain transmitting position of the system information from the frequency domain transmitting position.
5. The method according to claim 1, wherein obtaining the time domain transmitting position of the system information based on the feature information and the correspondence comprises:

determining a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a frequency of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determining a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determining a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a scrambling code sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence; and obtaining the time domain transmitting position of the system information from the time domain transmitting position range.

6. A method for transmitting system information, applied to a network side, configured to be applied in a scenario where a cell transmits a plurality of synchronization signals and has a plurality of pieces of system information and comprising:

7. The method according to claim 6, wherein determining the transmitting position of the system information based on the feature information and the correspondence further comprises: obtaining a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on the feature information and the correspondence.
8. The method according to claim 7, wherein obtaining the frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on the feature information and the correspondence comprises:

determining a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a frequency of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determining a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determining a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a scrambling code sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determining a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a frequency domain position of the synchronization signal and the correspondence; and obtaining the frequency domain transmitting position of the system information from the frequency domain transmitting position.
9. The method according to claim 6, wherein obtaining the time domain transmitting position of the system information based on the feature information and the correspondence comprises:

determining a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a frequency of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determining a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determining a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a scrambling code sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence; and obtaining the time domain transmitting position of the system information from the time domain transmitting position range.
10. The method according to claim 6, further comprising: presetting the correspondence between the feature information and the transmitting position of the system information.
11. A terminal, configured to be operable in a scenario where a cell transmits a plurality of synchronization signals and has a plurality of pieces of system information and comprising:

12. The terminal according to claim 11, wherein the first processing module comprises: an obtaining sub-module, configured to directly obtain a locally pre-stored correspondence between the feature information and the transmitting position of the system information; or a first processing sub-module, configured to obtain a correspondence between the feature information and the transmitting position of the system information based on the node information.

13. The terminal according to claim 11, wherein the second processing sub-module is further configured to obtain a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on the feature information and the correspondence;

wherein the second processing sub-module comprises: a first determining unit, configured to determine a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a frequency of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determine a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determine a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a scrambling code sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determine a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a frequency domain position of the synchronization signal and the correspondence; and a first processing unit, configured to obtain the frequency domain transmitting position of the system information from the frequency domain transmitting position; or, wherein the second processing sub-module comprises: a second determining unit, configured to determine a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a frequency of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determine a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determine a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a scrambling code sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence; and a second processing unit, configured to obtain the time domain transmitting position of the system information from the time domain transmitting position range.

14. A network reception and transmission node, configured to be operable in a scenario where a cell transmits a plurality of synchronization signals and has a plurality of pieces of system information and comprising:

15. The network reception and transmission node according to claim 14, wherein the third processing module comprises: a third processing sub-module, configured to obtain a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on the feature information and the correspondence;

wherein third determining unit is further configured to determine a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a frequency of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determine a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determine a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a scrambling code sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determine a frequency domain transmitting position of the system information based on a frequency domain position of the synchronization signal and the correspondence; and a third processing unit, configured to obtain the frequency domain transmitting position of the system information from the frequency domain transmitting position; or, wherein the third processing sub-module comprises: a fourth determining unit, configured to determine a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a frequency of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determine a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence, or determine a time domain transmitting position range of the system information based on a scrambling code sequence of the synchronization signal and the correspondence; and a fourth processing unit, configured to obtain the time domain transmitting position of the system information from the time domain transmitting position range.
